title: Taxonomies: Create a Taxonomy and Organize Its Terms | Orchard Core
description:
Grouping content under shared labels helps people find it, and a flat list of labels stops helping as it grows.

A taxonomy in Orchard Core is a content item that holds a list of terms, and a term can contain other terms. You create the taxonomy in the admin, choose the content type of its terms, add, edit, delete and drag the terms into a hierarchy, and publish the result.

In this video:
• What a taxonomy holds: terms, their hierarchy and their content type
• Create a taxonomy from Content Items
• Add terms at the top level and inside other terms
• Edit and delete terms
• Organize the hierarchy by dragging
• Publish the taxonomy
